body_lead: The Andhra Pradesh government has outlined an investment roadmap for the proposed Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER), with plans to mobilise Rs 9.3 lakh crore across infrastructure, industry and technology to transform North Andhra into a major economic and logistics hub. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu reviewed the master plan for the project during a meeting at his camp office in Undavalli, where officials presented the proposed development strategy and key investment priorities.
